# Prediction Lab

> AI-powered sports betting picks and probability-based projections. Four independent models compare projected win probabilities to sportsbook lines to surface potential value on moneyline, spread, and totals markets. Operated by GoodsandMore Inc. (Canada).

Prediction Lab is a multi-sport analytics site for bettors who want transparent, data-driven picks—not guaranteed outcomes. Picks are informational and educational. Sports betting involves risk and variance.

Important notes:

- Four separate AI models (ensemble + individual views) produce win probabilities for each game; consensus and disagreement are shown openly.
- Model projections are compared to sportsbook implied probabilities to highlight potential positive expected value (+EV), not to promise wins.
- Graded results are tracked publicly on sport-specific and all-sports results pages.
- Free daily moneyline picks are available; premium plans add spread, totals, score projections, and deeper tools.
- Canonical site URL: https://predictionlab.io
- Contact: support.predictionlab@gmail.com (web form: https://predictionlab.io/contact)

- [All sports results](https://predictionlab.io/all-sports-results): Cross-sport season performance dashboard
- [Model performance](https://predictionlab.io/performance): Historical model accuracy and audit data
- [FAQ](https://predictionlab.io/faq): How picks work, value methodology, refunds, and expectations
